role: Gov. Code §815.2 entity liability — City of Antioch vicariously liable for officers' tortious conduct in scope of employment; §815.6 mandatory duty (POST DV Response Guidelines)
theory_of_liability: Gov. Code §815.2: City of Antioch is vicariously liable for its officers' tortious acts committed in the scope of employment. Gov. Code §815.6: public entity liable for failure to discharge mandatory duty — POST DV Response Guidelines impose mandatory duties on officers responding to DV calls, including custody verification. The March 21, 2026 APD forensic audit found 10 violations.
government_claim_prerequisite: Gov. Code §911.2 requires filing a government tort claim within 6 months of accrual (or 1 year with late claim application). June 16, 2023 incident — late claim application required under §911.4.
